CONTRIBUTE.Definition: give your work, money or effort to help

SHORTCUT.Definition: a quicker way of getting something

HANDSOMELY.Definition: generously, with a lot of money

PRIVILEGE.Definition: a special right or advantage that only some people get

CASH.Definition: money, rather than other things of value

FEE.Definition: an amount of money paid for a service

CAPITAL GAINS.Definition: profits made from selling things such as property or shares

UNSTABLE.Definition: likely to have sudden political problems or violence

SEIZE.Definition: take by force or by legal power

ASSETS.Definition: things of value that someone owns, such as money or property

FEES.Definition: amounts of money paid for a service

FELLOW.Definition: belonging to the same group as you

PENSIONS.Definition: regular payments made to people after they stop working, usually because of age

FOLLOWED SUIT.Definition: did the same thing as someone else had done

AISLE.Definition: a long, narrow passage between rows of shelves in a shop

TIMING.Definition: when something happens, especially whether it is a good moment

ODD.Definition: occasional; happening only now and then

SLICK.Definition: clever and professional, designed to impress and persuade

COMMISSION.Definition: an amount of money paid for selling something, usually a percentage of the price

SCARCITY.Definition: a situation where there is too little of something

WIDESPREAD.Definition: existing among many people or in many places

ALLEGATIONS.Definition: claims that someone has done something wrong, not yet proved

CORRUPTION.Definition: dishonest behaviour by people in power, especially taking money

CRONYISM.Definition: the unfair practice of people in power giving jobs or advantages to their friends

THEORETICAL.Definition: existing in the rules but not really in practice

POCKET CHANGE.Definition: a very small amount of money

TENANTS.Definition: people who pay rent to live in a property owned by someone else

GATHERED PACE.Definition: grew quickly and became more active

SOVEREIGN.Definition: complete and independent, not controlled by others

UNEASE.Definition: a feeling of worry or discomfort

PASSING COMMENT.Definition: a brief remark made while talking about something else

VETTED.Definition: checked carefully to make sure they were suitable and honest

ASSASSINATION.Definition: the murder of an important or well-known person, often for political reasons

MONEY LAUNDERING.Definition: hiding where illegal money came from by moving it through legal businesses or accounts

INFRINGEMENT PROCEEDINGS.Definition: formal legal steps taken against a country for breaking the rules

DISAPPROVAL.Definition: a feeling that something is wrong or unacceptable

SOVEREIGNTY.Definition: the complete power of a country to govern itself

DUE DILIGENCE.Definition: careful checks made on people or businesses before an agreement

COSMETIC.Definition: only changing how something looks, not how it really is

LEAKS.Definition: cases of secret information being made public

DISPUTE.Definition: a disagreement, especially a formal one

AMOUNTS TO.Definition: is the same as; has the effect of

PRICE TAG.Definition: a label showing what something costs; a price

CONFRONT.Definition: deal with directly, even though it is difficult
